limitations: Nonblind Codex AI coding assistants, implementation contributors; identities available but predicted rankings withheld until product annotations are fixed. No human validation or inter-rater reliability claim.
Scores are AI visual/source proxies, not human relevance or objective ground truth.
Lightweight/travel is an appearance proxy with explicit-source exception; weight/performance were not measured.
Unknowns remain null in qrels; main scores use known labels with zero unknown gain and disclose top10 coverage.
All-unknown0 and all-unknown3 are sensitivity scenarios, while separately reported conservative nDCG bounds allow independent unknown assignments.
Recall uses only known AI-proxy relevant items; no original primary human quality field is populated.

visual.interpretation: AI observations and ordinal summaries only; not human feedback, primary usable-concept results, calibrated quality, reference-geometry accuracy or commercial approval. Confidence intervals cover sampled prompt/object variability, not AI assessor bias.

shortlist_decisions.note: Null decisions remain unresolved. Conditional rates have different observed denominators; bounds are explicit worst/best unresolved-decision scenarios, not imputed scores. Complete-prompt comparisons are an additional coverage diagnostic and do not replace the frozen summary or human assessment.

reference_test.interpretation: Normalized shape; rigid-aligned scores explicitly reference-assisted, no absolute size/pose accuracy claim
